description_en: Deletes an IP or VPC whitelist entry for an instance. This operation supports only new-architecture instances whose VPC access points (or VPC PrivateLink access points) end with mq.amqp.aliyuncs.com
description_zh:
删除实例ip/vpc白名单；
只支持新架构实例，即VPC接入点（或者VPC PrivateLink 接入点）以mq.amqp.aliyuncs.com结尾的实例
name: RemoveInstanceWhiteList

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the instance for which you want to delete the whitelist entry
parameters.help_zh: 需要删除白名单的实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the whitelist entry. You can call the ListInstanceWhiteList operation to query the whitelist entry ID
parameters.name: white_list_item_id

parameters.help_en:
The whitelist type. Valid values:

1: VPCID whitelist type.
2: IP whitelist type.

If WhiteListItem is set to an IP address, set WhiteListType to 2. If WhiteListItem is set to a VPC ID, set WhiteListType to 1.

VPC whitelists apply only to instances whose VPC access points are of the anytunnel type. The VPC access points of the latest instances are of the PrivateLink type, so you cannot configure VPC whitelists for such instances
parameters.help_zh:
白名单类型。

WhiteListType为1，IP白名单类型；

WhiteListType为2，VPCID白名单类型；
parameters.name: white_list_type
